notes.title: Game Update V45
notes.content:
Attention all Heirs!

Today's patch is mostly a polish patch, focusing specifically around the Situation Room and map generation.  It includes many optimizations and fixes related to how the map nodes are scattered and connected.  These efforts should remove the chances of edge cases like having maps with no Launch Site, or showing incorrectly available routes when the Launch Site is in danger, or overrun cities being destroyed that can still be reached.

There are also some changes to city VIP visibility.  As the city becomes closer, more details about the city will become available.  A directly connected city will show full details as it does now.  A city 2 days away will show the number of VIPs and the category (weapons, callins, logistics or support), and a city 3 days away will show only the number of VIPs, but no details.  Finally, everything 4 days and further will be completely unknown as before.

[ GAMEPLAY ]
- Alpha Grunts will never spawn alone in a wave

[ HUD AND MENUS ]
- Situation Table gives increasing city details as the dropship gets closer
- Overrun cities always have known VIPs and possible Plethora types
- Icon touchups for general items, city rewards, logistics, plethora and weapons
- Tooltip additions for general categories
- Tooltip updates and fixes
- Fix some edge cases of inconsistent Situation Room UI navigation highlighting
- Fix mouse incorrectly hovering icons when using keyboard or controller

[ MISC ]
- Speculative fix for end of level crash
- Fix cases of flickering with Situation Table arrows
- Fixed some cases of cities incorrectly being destroyed too soon
- Some optimizations to Situation Table map and path generation
- Fix incorrect map route options when the Launch Site is in danger
- Fix some edge cases of a Launch Site not being made at all
- Plethora Prime will react properly to end of city Orbital Bombardment

notes.title: Game Update V44
notes.content:
Attention all Heirs!

This patch introduces several new gameplay changes primarily regarding the Logistics Center.  Most significantly, the Weapons Assembly and Command Operations tables will now no longer send Echion back after a project is completed.  Additionally, the Logistics tables can have their projects cancelled by long pressing the assignment keys.  The cancellation takes a bit over a second, and new projects will be assigned based on what's available, with the progress reset to 0.  Finally, Logistics tables have a diminishing return to assigned Echion; more Echion will still increase completion speeds, but each will contribute a little less.

Another new feature introduced in this patch are Scientists.  Scientists are escort missions that provide incremental upgrades to shields, logistics tables, or already unlocked weapons.  Scientists are available to be extracted after the city and all VIPs are already evacuated.  This means the longer a city can be held, the more scientists can be extracted, resulting in improved offensive and defensive capabilities!

While not directly related to gameplay, it is important to note that this patch will abandon any current campaigns in progress, however all unlocked meta rewards such as Gambits and Archives will remain.  Additionally, this patch includes the outcome of a project wide audit and cleanup, resulting in almost 1GB smaller total game size, and should result in slightly reduced video memory usage too.

[ CONTROLS ]
- Echion no longer return after completing a Logistics project (Weapons Assembly or Command Operations)
- Long press to abort in progress projects, works for Weapon Assembly and Command Operation tables
- Fix zoom function on camera look when using controller analogue sticks

[ GAMEPLAY ]
- Tables have diminishing returns on additional Echion.  2nd Echion is +50% faster, 3rd Echion is +25% faster
- Plethora stats (health, damage, speed) ramp up 200% faster (previously 100%) after the city is evacuated
- Scientists offer incremental upgrades after all VIPs and the city population is evacuated
- Assembly and Command Tables are activated at the currently unlocked tier.  Logistics Extension operations only activate new tables
- Slightly reduced max radius of Generator Overcharge damage
- Shields are deployed 2 at a time per shield drop operation

[ HUD AND MENUS ]
- Add loading hints for long press project replacement, diminishing returns on tables, and incremental improvements from scientists
- Add Tier and completion rates of Logistics Tables to Codex

[ MAPS ]
- Minor navmesh optimizations in Cities
- Grenades will no longer hit the Generator Tower

[ MISC ]
- Project files audit and cleanup, ~800MB packaged game size reduction, and minor video memory improvements
- Lots of spelling and grammatical corrections in the Codex
- Add small sub explosion sound effects while the generator is overloading
- Fix location of healing bubble effect on Echion
- Remove restriction of Tier 3 unlocks for Demo

notes.title: Full Release of Terra Exodus
notes.content:
Attention all Heirs!

This first patch of the New Year will serve as the exit from Steam Early Access and the also the introduction of Final Stand Mode.  Final Stand is a single city scenario where there is no population to evacuate, only VIPs.  Each VIP will unlock a weapon upgrade, Call In, Table upgrade or new Echion as usual, resulting in a more and more devastating arsenal throughout the course of a single city run against the endless building tides of Plethora!

There is lots of great ideas for Terra Exodus still left on the cutting room floor, so I'll continue to support the game with fixes or even features as questions or suggestions come up.  This patch also comes with a number of fixes, mostly related to the tutorials and general menu experience polish, as well as other small things here and there.

[ CONTROLS ]
- Fix case where an Active Uplink VIP Operation will also count as completing the next Operation in queue

[ GAMEPLAY ]
- New Final Stand Mode available from the Campaign Selection menu

- Call Ins and Shields are upgraded immediately after being upgraded if the Command Tables are the right tech tier (in Call In queue, any on Command Tables)
- Weapons that are upgraded past Tier 3 will get incremental upgrades to stats
- Project Tables that are upgraded past Tier 3 will get incremental completion speed bonuses
- Shields that are upgraded past Tier 3 will get incremental upgrades to stats
- Fix inconsistent Command or Assembly table tier unlocking if it was also unlocked temporarily from a Drop Sequence reward
- Increased chances of Plethora Surge waves events replacing normal waves from 10% to 20%
- Increased chances of a Plethora Prime wave event replacing a Plethora Surge from 20% to 25%
- Fix city population accounting issue with Game Summary

[ HUD AND MENUS ]
- Fix cases when Game Summary doesn't properly continue to New Game when unlocking an Archive Entry

notes.title: Game Update V42
notes.content:
Attention all Heirs!

This weekend's update is finally the addition of some small story elements filling out the world of Terra Exodus.  After every campaign, if at least a minor victory was achieved, an Archive Entry will be unlocked.  An entry in the Archives is a small peek into the lives of the survivors of the first invasion, and some of the days after Exodus begins.

To make room for this in the Situation Room, a new UI was designed to help get around a little.  This means the codex and the archives are now immediately available on beginning or resuming a campaign.  The current tech and weapon tiers list is also cleaned up a little to make things a little more clear of the current situation.  Finally, the expected Plethora pressure (indicating wave sizes, frequency, and intensity) is moved from the city view and is now indicated globally by its own progress bar.

This update also makes some adjustments to the internal handling and tracking of Save Games.  Metagame progress will be preserved (Achievements and unlocked Gambits), but any currently active campaign will need to be restarted.  Don't hesitate to let me know if any issues come up due to this.

[ TUTORIALS ]

[ MISC ]
- Add Archives story elements as mission rewards
- Fixed up some irregularities with Save Games handling
- Add new VIP Wesley Johnson for Archive Icons

notes.title: Game Update v39

Attention all Heirs!

Today's update is the final pre early access launch patch, rolling together fixes for a lot of small issues (and some bigger ones).  Tomorrow, September 25th, is finally Early Access release day!

There are also a few important gameplay changes, specifically regarding the Command Center, Active Uplinks, and how Tier 3 Call Ins are handled.  Call Ins and Shields will only get a free upgrade on an Active Uplink if the next Tier is unlocked.  Additionally, Command Tables can only build Tier 1 and Tier 2 Operations, meaning Tier 3 can only be deployed on a successful Active Uplink.

This weekend's update brings most changed to UI, in particular a new Loadout menu replacing the earlier Heir and Gambits menu.  The menu is intended to better show the consequences of gambit selection to the evacuation, as well as demonstrate exactly the Heirs' conditions.  In general, it should be easier and more intuitive to navigate heirs and gambit selection with both mouse and keyboard/gamepad.

The camera movement (with controller thumbsticks) adds a zoom to the movement as well at the extremities, which lets the more curious players check in on the frontlines.  While sorting this out, several camera inconsistencies were also ironed out.

As usual, if you run into any issues with continuing a campaign in progress from an old save, simply starting a new campaign should fix the issue.  This generally works for most campaign related issues.

notes.title: Game Update v37
notes.content:
Attention all Heirs!

This update features improvement to the Launch Mission game flow and Plethora Prime AI.  In addition to some wave tuning, the Launch missing will switch between rush waves (similar to when a city is evacuated) when a shuttle is being launched and back to normal waves afterwards.  However, resuming the normal waves will also trigger a mighty Plethora Prime!

Speaking of the Prime, it is now much more focused on getting to the end of the lane.  Getting itself in position to smash the generator is a top priority, smashing anything that gets in its way!  The generator will also take a lot more damage from the Prime, requiring only 2 blows to be destroyed.

Finally, shields get some all round upgrades, allowing each tier some regeneration after a small period of time without taking damage.  Tier 3 Shields take only a few seconds before the regeneration starts, so make sure to score those Active Uplink bonuses!

[ GAMEPLAY ]

notes.title: Game Update v36
notes.content:
Attention all Heirs!

The biggest gameplay adjustment in this patch is for the way the generator handles damage.  Instead of only one hit for its destruction, it will now take a small amount of damage every time it is hit by the Plethora.  The damage adds to the Overdrive Meter, and when it fills up, the generator is destroyed.  A pass over the Heirs has Lauren now with a wrist mounted Shock Pack dealing fast electric damage at short range.  Maven's Gas Canister Launcher does damage over time to the afflicted Plethora, plus any Plethora close by.

Finally, the last level is now playable as the last level of the Tutorial.  This will give players a chance to try a shuttle launch mission in a low stakes environment, as well as get an early chance to see some of the Heir selection options.

notes.title: Game Update v35
notes.content:
Attention all Heirs!

This update is a bit later than expected, but comes with a redesigned final level for the shuttle launch site, made with new buildings and a slightly modified objective.

Every city evacuated leading up to the launch site will be designated a launch shuttle, and each shuttle requires a pilot.  Once the pilot is successfully escorted to the shuttle, it will be granted clearance for blastoff, filling the streets with flames dangerous to Echion, Shields, and Plethora the same.  If the Plethora manage to break through, any shuttles not already launched are lost, enire cities might be left behind!

Other important gameplay additions include removing the Assembly Table tier requirement to assemble weapons.  Once unlocked, weapons can be built at tables regardless of the their level.  On the other side of the logistics center, the VIP operation will always need Echion escorts.  An active uplink will reduce the number required, but an escort is always necessary.

[ GAMEPLAY ]
 - VIPs now require 1 Echion with Active Uplink, 3 otherwise
 - VIP considerably more heavily weighted to be the next Command Table project
 - Weapons no longer require an assembly table of the same tier
 - Assembly tables will try to keep a 4-1 standard-heavy weapon ratio in ammo crate
 - Fix case where Drop In rewards don't stop

[ HUD AND MENUS ]
 - New Codex entry for Pilots
 - Hide generator overload helper icons when generator is going critical
 - Centered uplink progress bar
 - Lane indicators on shields range between 0-200 instead of 0-100

[ MAPS ]
 - Shuttle Launch site level redesign
 - Minor navmesh optimizations for static level props
 - Minor optimizations for procedural tree placement
 - Fix seed initialization for vegetation builder

[ TUTORIALS ]

notes.title: Game Update v34
notes.content:
Attention all Heirs!

This update is entirely focused in the situation room.  Two new city types are introduced, abandoned and launch sites.

Abandoned cities are those that are already evacuated, and don't contribute to population lost or saved.  Launch sites are where the final holdout will take place in the sector, where the populations of all evacuated cities will be finally loaded onto the escape rockets.  There is only Launch Site per sector, and if the invasion zone reaches it, the Launch Site must be defended and launched immediately.  All other missions are cancelled.

Estimated city population loss is now dynamic based on the zone it lands in.  Cities in the safe zone estimate a 5% population loss, invasion zone is 10%, and the overrun has a 15% estimated population loss.

[ CONTROLS ]
- Cities on the situation table are a bit "sticky" to the mouse hover

[ GAMEPLAY ]
- New city type Abandoned
- New city type Launch Site
- Estimated population loss based on map zone
- All Unreachable cities have hidden VIP rewards
- Increase standard starting weapons from 2 to 5 when rewarded during drop in
- Increase heavy starting weapons from 1 to 3 when rewarded during drop in
- Artillery drones, marksmen teams, and towers will stop when the generator is going critical

[ HUD AND MENUS ]
- Slightly reduced text size for city information boxes
- Fixed Statistic1 typo in City Summary UI
- Fix location of Assembly Logistics Recall floating button

[ MAPS ]
- Echion will no longer walk through the Operations Center from the Bunker

[ TUTORIALS ]
- Tutorial campaign always starts with Airstrike Call In
- Rearrange Tutorial Cities to better demonstrate Hold Out mechanic
- Fix situation where Generator Overload could be done too early in Tutorial 1
- Remove section instructing to return an Echion from Logistics to Bunker in Tutorial 3

[ MISC ]
- Rework city connectivity and city highlighting logic on Situation Table

notes.title: Game Update v33
notes.content:
Attention all Heirs!

Today's update was mostly centered around the unification of the camera system between the dropship and the city gameplay.

This comes with a variety of polishing side effects, such as cleaning up situations where the camera could cut through the ship, or snap unexpectedly from old locations.  The camera has also been set up to allow a few degrees of rotation when using a controller with the controller thumbsticks.  This isn't intended to be a gameplay tool, but more for those a bit more curious about the environment, and to emphasize that the d-pad is required for gameplay.

[ CONTROLS ]
- Camera can be slightly directed with controller thumbsticks
- Enable mouse usage in settings menu in the city

- Added small menu closing animations between areas of the dropship

- Removed camera rotation from Situation Table when highlighting cities

- Fix Generator Overload time dilation during City Tutorial 1

notes.title: Game Update v32
notes.content:
Demo Update v32

This update tries to improve in game player guidance with new input cues when assigning and recalling Echion.

In addition to moving the Generator Overcharge input cues off the main HUD and next to the generator instead, the Generator is also sensitive to the Plethora now.  When they get close enough, the input icons will show up to suggest the player to begin an Overcharge.  Keep in mind though, the Overcharge will easy kill off nearby Plethora, but it will also damage your shields, and will blow your generator if you go too far!

Other improvements with input suggestions and general player feedback include floating buttons for Recall, and new effects for Echion assignments, recall zones, and assignments when the muster pool is empty.

[ GAMEPLAY ]
- Reduction in size of Hold Back waves after the city is fully evacuated
- Echion will pick an available Logistics table with most open slots. If all activated tables have the same number of open slots, a random table will be assigned.
- When trying to assign to the walls but there is no ammo stock, A.L.I will sometimes remind that weapon stocks are empty

[ HUD AND MENUS ]
- Added floating Generator Overcharge input indicators to beside the generator.  Visible when Plethora are close, or when Next Operation or Previous Operation (or both) is held down
- Added floating Recall input indicators next to walls and logistics zones.  Visible when at least 1 Echion is occupying a relevant zone
- Added Game Setting to enable or disable all floating helper input indicators
- Added new Generator Overcharge progress indicator around generator base
- Zone selection effect when the Recall button is held.  Only zones with Echion already assigned will be visible
- New Echion assignment effects from all zones
- New empty muster pool effect
- Removed Generator Overcharge input hints from the Uplink Operations HUD

[ MAPS ]
- Reduced shininess of wall and tower zones

notes.title: Game Update v31
notes.content:
Attention all Heirs!

The update was mostly finding and ironing out the crash that often happened at the end of a city.

This update also adds controls to change the current operation.  This is especially handy during the final hold back sections, since sometimes you can be sitting on a big inventory of Call Ins ready to go, but what you really want is to drop in some replacement shields.  While doing this, it started to make sense to add better indications for Generator Overcharging in general, and that finally resulted in moving the Overcharge functions to the new Operation changing keys.  It takes a bit of dexterity, but it's now possible to Overcharge, and assign or recall Echion at the bunker and the logistics center, and trigger a Call In all at the same time!

[ CONTROLS ]
 - Space || Right Trigger --> Active Uplink
 - Left Shift || Left Trigger --> Recall Modifier
 - E || Right Shoulder --> Next Operation
 - Q || Left Shoulder --> Previous Operation
 - Q + E || Left + Right Shoulder --> Generator Overcharge

[ GAMEPLAY ]
 - Added controls for Next Operation and Previous Operation to allow scrolling through ready Operations
 - Changed the Generator Overcharge to be a combination of the new Next and Previous Operation commands instead of pressing both Recall keys
 - Mission Prep Rewards can't be triggered until the uplink is more than 10% done to prevent accidental trigger on start

[ HUD AND MENUS ]
 - Add HUD items to indicate when the next or previous Operation can be picked.  These also indicate the Overcharge option when Next or Previous is held down
 - Slightly offset Generator Overcharge progress bar from Uplink progress, and placed on top for better visibility
 - Fix muster zone assignment prompts not appearing until after the first time a Recall button was pressed
 - Fix Input Settings menu off by one when scrolling with controller

[ TUTORIALS ]
 - Add Mission Prep Rewards tutorial prompts at the beginning of the third tutorial city shortly after leaving the dropship
 - Updated commands for Generator Overcharge at the end of the first tutorial city

[ MISC ]
 - Fix hard crash when loading back to the drop ship
